value.rationale: The result identifies a structurally motivated state-domain failure in a recent ecological model: reversal of Smith resource feedback above carrying capacity under prey scarcity yields sharp ODE runaway/superexponential prey loss, whereas every fixed forward-Euler step produces a finite nonphysical prey value. An explicit open initial-state set and exact exit bound guide interpretation of biological domains and long-run simulations, not just a routine single-parameter negative iterate.
